inputs.name: ResendEmailAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: The settings the instance keeps: apiKey, sent as the Bearer token; from, sent as the sender; and fetch, the function that performs the POST. The constructor stores this object as given without validating it, and createResendDelivery is the path that checks apiKey and from.

inputs.name: ResendEmailAdapter.send.message
inputs.description: The proof to deliver: email is the only recipient, and code, the eight-digit code that emailCode generates, is written into the plain-text body. The adapter never reads expiresAt; the body always says the code expires in 10 minutes.

inputs.name: createResendDelivery.env
inputs.description: The environment object whose HARNESS_EMAIL_API_KEY and HARNESS_EMAIL_FROM are read; every AuthEnv value is optional, and a missing or malformed email setting makes createResendDelivery return null. The API key must be 8 to 200 characters of letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, and the sender must be a bare address or 'Name <address>'.

inputs.name: createResendDelivery.fetcher
inputs.description: The fetch function that ResendEmailAdapter calls for its POST to https://api.resend.com/emails, with redirect set to 'manual' and a 10-second timeout signal. Defaults to (input, init) => fetch(input, init), which calls the global fetch with the same arguments.

outputs.name: ResendEmailAdapter.send
outputs.description: Resolves with no value once Resend answers with a 2xx status and a JSON body, read up to MAX_RESPONSE (4096), whose id is a string. Any other outcome rejects with an AuthFailure whose code is 'email-delivery-failed'.

outputs.name: createResendDelivery
outputs.description: Returns a ResendEmailAdapter, typed as EmailProofDelivery, when HARNESS_EMAIL_API_KEY and HARNESS_EMAIL_FROM are both present and well formed, and null otherwise. There is no fallback sender, so an invalid value in either setting disables delivery.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: Thrown with code 'email-delivery-failed' (status 502) when fetch throws, including the 10-second timeout, when Resend answers with a status outside 2xx (a redirect is never followed), or when a 2xx body cannot be read as JSON with a string id. Provider text is never included.
